release_command: ./scripts/ops/opsctl.sh production-soak-enhancement --apply --json --exit-zero && ./scripts/ops/opsctl.sh production-readiness --apply --json --exit-zero && ./.venv314/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_dependency_activation_smoke.py tests/test_production_readiness_control.py tests/test_production_soak_enhancement.py tests/test_library_utilization_router.py tests/test_mlx_intelligence_router.py

soak_enhancements.soak_enhancement: Adds repeated dependency compatibility evidence without mutating the live runtime.
Lets the soak prove that live submit attempts reject by default before broker API calls.
Turns each soak cycle into a fingerprint comparison against stable replay inputs.
Gives operators one repeatable gate command instead of scattered manual checks.
Checks that telemetry samples redact secrets, account IDs, and order IDs before exporters are enabled.
Keeps production-core libraries staged until installation and import smoke pass.
Proves rollback inputs and operator commands are hashable before promotion.
Makes soak readiness visible in the normal operator cockpit/report path.
